items.title: Ferrand Clementin Interview, 1973-08-02
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah. And what about the promenade, Shadi? Did you have a good one?

ctx.x: I used to work at Air Travelers in the Sea North Country. And I used to put in there and go all around the valley. And that used to call it the two-lane bell. Two-lane bell. It used to be St. Joe and whatever. Come this way. And two-lane bell used to come with the same rod, not the St. Joe and the bell. Not illegal to me because he had the same show except for me that. And they go and it's called a beautiful dress like that.
Yeah. And what about the promenade, Shadi? Did you have a good one?
Oh, yes, indeed. I used to dance to all of them. You want to make a movie of them.
